turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oof, yeah, climbing calluses and guitar strings can be a brutal mix! You've got to give those fingers a rest sometimes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely. I'll probably just take it easy tonight and relax.

turns.speaker: assistant
